en.description: Wenzhang Du studies how language models use retrieved evidence and how reliably evaluations measure their behavior.
en.role: Data mining, RAG & trustworthy machine learning
heroStatement: I test one change at a time.
en.heroIntro: I work on retrieval and model evaluation. I compare answers to the same question as I vary a passage, an example or a scoring rule.
en.degree: B.Eng. in Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence
en.aboutLead: Two systems can earn the same score for different reasons. I use paired tests to find out which decisions produced that score.
aboutParagraphs: I have a B.Eng. in Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence. My work on language-model evaluation draws on earlier research in model auditing, efficient deep learning, computer vision and remote sensing.

research.title: Data mining & RAG
research.description: With the question fixed, I vary which passages enter the context, how many are allowed and the order the generator reads them in.

research.title: Trustworthy machine learning
research.description: I build paired tests that distinguish ranking from deciding, and fitting the examples from generalizing to new inputs. I report how much uncertainty remains in each comparison.

recentResearch: My WSDM study began with a practical choice in retrieval-augmented generation. When a model proposes several passages, is it worth spending one more scoring call to check them together? I compared that extra call with returning the best context already measured, then checked whether the generated answer also improved.

I use the same approach to ask what an evaluation actually tests. In program induction, changing one demonstration can rule out every single-rule solution. In refusal evaluation, a model can rank a safe and an unsafe prompt correctly yet apply the wrong decision to one of them. Each comparison makes a different failure visible.

zh.description: Wenzhang Du，独立研究者，研究语言模型如何使用检索到的证据，以及如何可靠地评估模型行为。
zh.role: 数据挖掘、检索增强生成与可信机器学习
zh.heroEyebrow: 独立研究者 · 个人学术主页
heroStatement: 哪些证据会改变模型的回答？
我一次改变一个条件，追查原因。
zh.heroIntro: 我研究检索和模型评估。我会固定问题，只改一段证据、一个示例或一条评分规则，再比较答案怎样变化。
zh.degree: 计算机工程与人工智能学士学位
zh.aboutLead: 两个系统得到同样的分数，背后的原因可能很不一样。我用配对实验追查，是哪些具体决定产生了这个结果。
aboutParagraphs: 我拥有计算机工程与人工智能学士学位。此前在模型审计、高效深度学习、计算机视觉和遥感方面的研究，也影响了我今天评估语言模型的方式。

research.title: 数据挖掘与 RAG
research.description: 我固定问题，分别改变模型能读几段证据、读到哪些段落，以及先读哪一段。

research.title: 可信机器学习
research.description: 我用配对测试区分排对顺序与作对决定，也区分通过已给样例与推广到新输入，并估计每项比较的不确定性。

recentResearch: 我的 WSDM 研究从检索增强生成中的一个决定开始。模型提出一组段落后，值不值得再花一次评分调用，把它们放在一起测？我用已有测量中得分最高的上下文作对照，然后检查生成的答案是否也有改善。
我也用类似的比较追问，一项评估究竟测到了什么。在程序归纳中，更换一个示例就可能排除全部单规则解。在拒答评估中，即使把安全与不安全提示排对了，模型也可能对其中一条作出错误决定。两种实验各自揭示一种容易被总分掩盖的失败。
